definition: working under and helping another person
description: In an elegant tailor's shop with dark wooden cabinets full of folded cloth and green glass lamps, a young man in a navy suit stands on a low wooden box and looks down while a smiling young woman in a navy pinstripe top and cream trousers fastens the button of his jacket. Beside her a golden retriever wearing a small navy waistcoat sits holding a wooden tray with a red pincushion in its mouth. At the end she straightens up and pats the dog's head. A patterned red rug covers the wooden parquet floor.

de.answer: Sie richtet die Jacke des Mannes.
de.question: Was macht die Frau?

es.answer: Está arreglando la chaqueta del hombre.
